visual_elements.description: Fully connected feed-forward network, left panel. Header 'Input Word X' (word 'X' in red). Four pink circular input nodes stacked vertically, labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄. Four white circular neurons to their right, each containing 'Σ' plus a small sigmoid-curve glyph, and a tiny multicolor pie icon (blue/purple/green wedges) on the neuron's left rim. All 16 input-to-neuron connections drawn as thin light-purple lines. Weight labels grouped by source node: beside X₁ (blue): W₁₁, W₂₁, W₃₁, W₄₁; beside X₂ (purple): W₁₂, W₂₂, W₃₂, W₄₂; beside X₃ (orange): W₁₃, W₂₃, W₃₃, W₄₃; beside X₄ (green): W₁₄, W₂₄, W₃₄, W₄₄. Each neuron emits a short green arrow to the right ending at labels y₁, y₂, y₃, y₄; each neuron also receives a short green arrow from below coming from labels b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄.

Equation-as-graphic, right panel, reading left to right: (1) red 'Y' with superscript 'T' above a horizontal row of four yellow rounded boxes labeled y₁, y₂, y₃, y₄; (2) blue bold-italic text '= Sigmoid'; (3) large dark-blue curly brace '{'; (4) horizontal row of four pink rounded boxes labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ with a red bold 'X' centered beneath them; (5) a 4×4 matrix on a light-green rounded rectangle, each cell a small yellow box: row 1 = W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁ (blue text), row 2 = W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂ (purple text), row 3 = W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃ (orange text), row 4 = W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄ (green text); (6) large dark-blue curly brace '}'; (7) red bold '+' sign; (8) a vertical column of four yellow rounded boxes labeled b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄ enclosed by a pair of large red parentheses. Overall meaning: Yᵀ = Sigmoid( X·W + b ).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with dark-red outline containing the numeral '9' in dark red, positioned at the top-right corner.
Small white mouse-pointer arrow with black outline floating in the empty area of the right panel below the y₁–y₄ row (screen-capture artifact of the live presentation).

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Iconography only: four Σ neuron circles each with a small sigmoid-curve glyph and a multicolor (blue/purple/green) pie icon on the left rim; four pink circular input nodes; yellow rounded number badge '9'; small white mouse-cursor arrow in the right panel.
typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Tahoma-like) throughout. Title ~28pt bold, red, title case with wide double spaces after 'Using' and 'FF NN'. Panel header 'Input Word X' ~14pt bold black with the 'X' enlarged and red. All indices are true subscripts (X₁, W₁₁, y₁, b₁); 'Yᵀ' uses a superscript T. '= Sigmoid' is bold italic blue. Weight labels ~9pt bold, color-coded by source node. No all-caps text, no serif fonts, no numbered bullets.

recreation_brief:
1. Slide setup: create a 4:3 slide with background #E8E8E8 and draw a thin dark-red (#800000) rectangular frame along the slide edge.
2. Title: text box spanning x 8–86%, y 8–16%, centered text 'Using  FF NN  for Multiplication of a Vector by a Matrix' (keep the double spaces after 'Using' and 'FF NN'), Arial bold 28pt, #C00000.
3. Slide-number badge: circle ~0.5" diameter at x 88–94%, y 8–16%, fill #FFFF99, outline #800000 1.5pt, containing the centered bold numeral '9' in #800000.
4. Left panel: rounded rectangle x 7–29%, y 17–97%, fill #FFFFFF, outline #404040 1.5pt.
5. Panel header: top-left inside the left panel, one text line 'Input Word ' in Arial bold 14pt #000000 followed by 'X' in Arial bold 18pt #C00000.
6. Input nodes: four circles ~0.35" diameter, fill #FF99CC, outline #CC6699, at x≈10% and y≈27%, 49%, 66%, 84%; label them X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (black bold, true subscripts).
7. Neurons: four circles ~0.45" diameter, fill #FFFFFF, outline #808080, at x≈24% and the same four y positions as step 6; inside each place 'Σ' (~16pt) with a small sigmoid-curve glyph, and add a tiny multicolor pie icon (blue/purple/green wedges) on the left rim of each neuron.
8. Connections: 16 straight lines, 0.75pt #CC99CC, one from every input node to every neuron (fully connected 4×4).
9. Weight-label group 1: beside X₁ place W₁₁, W₂₁, W₃₁, W₄₁ (~9pt bold, true subscripts) in #0033CC.
10. Weight-label group 2: beside X₂ place W₁₂, W₂₂, W₃₂, W₄₂ in #9933CC.
11. Weight-label group 3: beside X₃ place W₁₃, W₂₃, W₃₃, W₄₃ in #FF9900.
12. Weight-label group 4: beside X₄ place W₁₄, W₂₄, W₃₄, W₄₄ in #009900.
13. Output arrows: from each neuron one short rightward arrow in #009900 ending at its label y₁, y₂, y₃ or y₄ (green bold) to the right of the neuron.
14. Bias arrows: below each neuron one short upward arrow in #009900 running from its label b₁, b₂, b₃ or b₄ (green bold) into the neuron.
15. Right panel: rounded rectangle x 30–93%, y 17–56%, fill #EEEEEE, outline #404040 1.5pt; steps 16–23 place the equation components left to right on one horizontal line vertically centered in this panel (y≈36%).
16. Output vector: red (#C00000) bold 'Y' with superscript 'T' (~20pt) placed above a horizontal row of four rounded boxes (fill #FFFF99, border #E6A23C) labeled y₁, y₂, y₃, y₄.
17. '= Sigmoid': bold-italic text in #0000CC placed to the right of the y-row.
18. Opening brace: large '{' in #000099.
19. Input vector: horizontal row of four rounded boxes (fill #FF99CC, border #C00000) labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, with bold red 'X' (#C00000) centered beneath the row.
20. Weight matrix: rounded rectangle filled #CCFFCC containing a 4×4 grid of small yellow (#FFFF99) cells with true-subscript labels — row 1: W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁ in #0033CC; row 2: W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂ in #9933CC; row 3: W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃ in #FF9900; row 4: W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄ in #009900.
21. Closing brace: large '}' in #000099, matching step 18.
22. Plus sign: bold '+' in #C00000.
23. Bias vector: a pair of large red (#C00000) parentheses enclosing a vertical column of four yellow (#FFFF99) rounded boxes labeled b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄ from top to bottom.
24. Optional fidelity: small white mouse-cursor arrow with black outline at ~x 42%, y 51% inside the right panel (screen-capture artifact; may be omitted).
25. Bottom strip: solid black (#000000) rectangle across the full slide width at y 97–100% (video-player strip captured with the frame; may be omitted in a clean rebuild).
